take: Cloud & Wind Golf makes one thing — grips — and they make them differently. Every design draws from traditional Eastern aesthetics and Pacific Coast nature. The Blossom series pulls from floral motifs and Chinese poetry. The Cloud & Wave collection captures the mood of twilight rounds on the California coast. The Zen strips everything back to texture and tone. Each grip ships with a line of Chinese verse printed along the shaft — a detail most brands would never think to include.
story_extra: The construction is straightforward: natural and synthetic rubber blend, Standard+ sizing with a gentle taper, 56–58 grams, rated for 60 rounds. At $18 a grip, they're priced below the big names but built with more intention than anything in the pro shop. Bundles drop the per-grip cost further — a 3-grip set runs $50, a 7-grip set is $112. The new Pacific Summer collection just landed with three colorways inspired by June Gloom mornings and SoCal sunsets. This is a grip brand for golfers who care about what they touch 50+ times a round.
